description: A sleek and modern white pendant light designed for contemporary spaces. It features a long, rectangular shade that hangs from a minimalist rectangular canopy by two thin wires. The shade itself appears to be made of a translucent material, suggesting it will diffuse light softly. The overall design is clean and unfussy, prioritizing form and function. Its simple geometric shape makes it a versatile lighting solution that can complement various interior design schemes, from Scandinavian to industrial.
